entities.html: abbrev Theory := Set Tm
entities.htmlGroup: abbrev Theory := Set Tm
entities.name: Kripke.Canonical.Theory

entities.html:
def ProvableFrom (T : Theory) (φ : Tm) : Prop :=
  ∃ Γ : Ctxt, (∀ ψ ∈ Γ, ψ ∈ T) ∧ Pf Γ φ
entities.htmlGroup:
def ProvableFrom (T : Theory) (φ : Tm) : Prop :=
  ∃ Γ : Ctxt, (∀ ψ ∈ Γ, ψ ∈ T) ∧ Pf Γ φ
entities.name: Kripke.Canonical.ProvableFrom

entities.html:
def Closed (T : Theory) : Prop :=
  ∀ ⦃φ : Tm⦄, ProvableFrom T φ → φ ∈ T
entities.htmlGroup:
def Closed (T : Theory) : Prop :=
  ∀ ⦃φ : Tm⦄, ProvableFrom T φ → φ ∈ T
entities.name: Kripke.Canonical.Closed

entities.html:
def Consistent (T : Theory) : Prop :=
  Tm.ff ∉ T
entities.htmlGroup:
def Consistent (T : Theory) : Prop :=
  Tm.ff ∉ T
entities.name: Kripke.Canonical.Consistent

entities.html:
def Prime (T : Theory) : Prop :=
  ∀ ⦃φ ψ : Tm⦄, (φ ∨ ψ) ∈ T → φ ∈ T ∨ ψ ∈ T
entities.htmlGroup:
def Prime (T : Theory) : Prop :=
  ∀ ⦃φ ψ : Tm⦄, (φ ∨ ψ) ∈ T → φ ∈ T ∨ ψ ∈ T
entities.name: Kripke.Canonical.Prime

entities.html: def closure (T : Theory) : Theory := {φ | ProvableFrom T φ}
entities.htmlGroup: def closure (T : Theory) : Theory := {φ | ProvableFrom T φ}
entities.name: Kripke.Canonical.closure

entities.html:
structure Admissible (S : Theory) (A : Tm) (T : Theory) : Prop where
  base : S ⊆ T
  closed : Closed T
  consistent : Consistent T
  avoids : A ∉ T
entities.htmlGroup:
structure Admissible (S : Theory) (A : Tm) (T : Theory) : Prop where
  base : S ⊆ T
  closed : Closed T
  consistent : Consistent T
  avoids : A ∉ T
entities.name: Kripke.Canonical.Admissible.base
